page.notes: Page is one column of text. No marginal notes. The small dot before "ter" at the top left and the marks along the left edge are printer or scan artefacts, not transcribed. Italic boundaries in the first and second paragraphs are approximate from the scan. "dilutum·" keeps the printed middle dot. "sicum" in the second paragraph is probably a misreading of "ficum" (the scan reads "ficum iis"); it is transcribed here as printed in the scan as "sicum" and may be "siccum" or "ficum". Printed "verò" and "Qua" are kept as read.
